{"version":"2b1","blocks":[{"type":"text","text":"Compare Native Hybrid, Tauri, and Electron by three criteria: native experience, lightweight runtime, and delivery efficiency. Adjust weights to see how the overall scores and rankings change. Scores are synthetic and weighted by normalized weights."},{"type":"ui","source":"root = Stack([weights,nativeHybridScore,tauriScore,electronScore,ranks])

weights = Stack([weightNative,weightLightweight,weightDelivery])
weightNative = Control("Weight: Native Experience", 40, 0, [0,100], $wNative)
weightLightweight = Control("Weight: Lightweight Runtime", 25, 0, [0,100], $wLightweight)
weightDelivery = Control("Weight: Delivery Efficiency", 35, 0, [0,100], $wDelivery)

// sum of weights
sumWeights = $wNative + $wLightweight + $wDelivery

// normalized weights or zero if sum is zero
normNative = sumWeights == 0 ? 0 : $wNative / sumWeights
normLightweight = sumWeights == 0 ? 0 : $wLightweight / sumWeights
normDelivery = sumWeights == 0 ? 0 : $wDelivery / sumWeights

// scores for each platform
scoreNativeHybrid = normNative * 9 + normLightweight * 8 + normDelivery * 7
scoreTauri = normNative * 7 + normLightweight * 8 + normDelivery * 8
scoreElectron = normNative * 6 + normLightweight * 4 + normDelivery * 10

nativeHybridScore = Metric("Native Hybrid Score", scoreNativeHybrid)
tauriScore = Metric("Tauri Score", scoreTauri)
electronScore = Metric("Electron Score", scoreElectron)

// list of platforms and scores
platforms = [
  {name: "Native Hybrid", score: scoreNativeHybrid},
  {name: "Tauri", score: scoreTauri},
  {name: "Electron", score: scoreElectron}
]

// rank descending or empty if all zero weights
ranks = sumWeights == 0 ? Text("No ranking: all weights are zero") : Table(@Sort(platforms, "score", "desc"))
","state":[{"name":"wNative","value":40},{"name":"wLightweight","value":25},{"name":"wDelivery","value":35}]}]}

At most one ui block contains only the requested protocol source and initial integer state entries (empty uses defaults). No fences. No JavaScript, tools, events, HTML or links. Names start with ASCII letter, then alphanumeric or underscore, at most 48 characters. All declarations must be reachable. Text and labels at most 512 characters. Safe Graphic items use kind plus only required fields: rect(x,y,width,height), circle(cx,cy,r), text(x,y,text), path(d using only M L H V Z, lowercase equivalents, numbers, spaces or commas), group(items of leaves). Numeric coordinates 0..640; viewBox 0 0 450 135.
One assignment per physical line. root = Stack([leafName, otherLeaf]). Each leaf is one named call: Text("text"), Metric("label",numericValue), Control("label",literalMin,literalMax,choices,$variable), Table([{label:"name",score:number}]), Graphic("label",items). Declare $variable = integer and bind it to exactly one Control. Use [] for range or literal string options indexed 0..n-1. Derived name = expression. Strings use double quotes. Numeric + - * /, == > <, condition ? yes : no, arrays, objects, named references, @Sum(numbers), @Sort(rows,"score","desc") are allowed. No unary minus, concatenation, member access, map, interpolation or inline nested components. Produce complete root and definitions.
